# utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method { #climatecritters.utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method }

```python
utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method(
    f,
    t_span,
    y0,
    dt,
    noise_func=None,
    rng=None,
    args=(),
    post_step=None,
)
```

Fixed-step Euler-Maruyama integrator for stochastic differential equations.

Solves:

    dy = f(t, y) dt + noise_func(t, y) dW

where ``dW`` is a Wiener increment with variance ``dt``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**f**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[callable](`callable`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Drift function with signature ``f(t, y, *args)``.

<code>[**t_span**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [tuple of float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   ``(t0, tf)`` integration bounds.

<code>[**y0**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Initial state vector.

<code>[**dt**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Fixed timestep.

<code>[**noise_func**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[callable](`callable`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Diffusion function with signature ``noise_func(t, y)``, returning a vector of per-state diffusion scales.  If ``None``, the stochastic term is zero and deterministic Euler is recovered.

<code>[**rng**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[numpy](`numpy`).[random](`numpy.random`).[Generator](`numpy.random.Generator`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Random generator for Wiener increments.  A fresh generator is created if ``None``.

<code>[**args**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[tuple](`tuple`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [()]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Extra positional arguments forwarded to ``f``.

<code>[**post_step**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[callable](`callable`) or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Optional hook called after each accepted step with signature ``post_step(t, y) -> y``.  The returned array replaces the current state, allowing post-step corrections (e.g. state nudging).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**solution**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Solution](`climatecritters.utils.solver.Solution`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Object with attributes ``t`` (time axis) and ``y`` (state trajectory).

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If ``noise_func`` returns a vector whose shape does not match the state vector.
